services.desc: Signature Cruise Experiences highly recommends that guests arrive in Tampa the day before embarkation to alleviate stress from any potential travel delays or issues. More guests miss the ship’s departure due to severe weather and missed flights than for any other reason. With so many different options of hotel properties in the Tampa area to choose from, if our guests act soon, they should have opportunities to select a hotel in whatever location or price range they desire. For those unfamiliar with the hotels in the area, Signature Cruise Experiences has compiled a list of potential hotels along with a direct link to each reservation procedure.
